morgan: Heads up — after flipping on cudagraphs for the multi-GPU TP+PP job on staging I see an ~18% tail latency regression. Seems intermittent but reproducible with the kv-prefetch path enabled.

samir: Timeline + repro?

morgan: ran: `./ci/run_infer_bench.sh --model=redwood-7B --tp=2 --pp=2 --batching=smart --use-cudagraphs=1 --kv-prefetch=on`

morgan: Quick nvprof/Nsight excerpt shows weird ordering:
```
[nsight] kernel matmul_opt      12.1 ms (stream 0)
[nsight] kernel async_prefetch   0.30 ms (stream 4)
[nsight] comm   allreduce        6.0 ms  (stream 0)  <-- expected overlap but shows serialized timing
```

samir: stream 4? prefetch landed off the capture stream? that would break capture assumptions.

jia: We recently changed kernel-selection to pick the ASYNC_COPY prefetch when seq_len < 64 (faster in isolation). That path uses a helper stream + pinned staging buffer.

nora: If prefetch is moving to a non-capture stream during capture, cudaGraph capture won't see the dependency ordering, so graph launch can serialize or reorder with NCCL. Need to confirm with NVTX.

morgan: Minimal capture snippet from the runtime (pseudo):
```cpp
cudaStream_t s = engine->getCaptureStream();
cudaStreamBeginCapture(s, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal);
// schedule matmul on s
matmul.launch(s);
// async prefetch uses helper stream h (NOT s)
kv_prefetch.launch(h); // used to be on s
// record event on h and streamWaitEvent(s, e) is missing during capture
// then we kick off NCCL allreduce on s
ncclAllReduce(..., s);
cudaStreamEndCapture(s, &graph);
```

arya: Sounds like we hit a stream-semantics mismatch: graph capture assumes everything relevant is on the capture stream or has explicit inter-stream events recorded before end-capture. The async_prefetch helper stream is invisible to the graph so its copies can happen after graph launch or block the capture.

samir: Another twist: kernel selector introduced an async memcpy using cuBLASLt internal kernels for small copies in that path. Those call into driver threads and don't behave nicely under capture.

nora: Actionable fixes:
- Force KV prefetch onto the capture stream when graphs are enabled (cheap), OR
- Emit an explicit cudaEvent recorded on helper stream and cudaStreamWaitEvent on capture stream before end-capture (more correct), OR
- Revert selector to synchronous copy path when graph_capture_active.

morgan: I'll prototype an option to pin prefetch to capture stream and run E2E. Also will add NVTX around prefetch + allreduce.

samir: Add a guard in kernel selector: `if (graph_capture_active) return SYNC_COPY` — avoids helper stream usage. That should be a small patch.

bench-bot: started job #4425: perf/regression/cudagraphs/kv-prefetch (TP2_PP2)

morgan: Also found a micro-bug: when sequence-length distribution changes (batching heuristic), we sometimes switch code-paths mid-capture which invalidates the graph. Need to ensure batching decisions are stable during capture or force fallback.

nora: Good point. Tests should lock the batching heuristic or record the chosen path as part of the graph key.

arya: For immediate mitigation we should flip off cudagraphs for TP+PP runs in the canary fleet until we land a fix.

samir: Agreed. I'll open a short-lived revert flag in runtime-config and a follow-up PR with the kernel-selector guard.

morgan: PR WIP: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/987 (will add NVTX + guard + unit).

deploy-bot: deploy: staging inference-stack v2.3.4 started

bench-bot: job #4425 queued on gpu-pool-staging-3 (will post logs)

samir: After the patch, run: `nsightui --launch ./ci/infer_e2e --model redwood-7B --tp 2 --pp 2 --cudagraphs=1` and inspect the timeline. Look for prefetch NVTX range before allreduce on the same stream.

morgan: thx. I'll run and paste NVTX snapshots. If overlap returns we can roll cudagraphs back on.

nora: Also add a regression test that toggles seq_len distribution and ensures graph stable.

morgan: ack. I'll follow up with logs and a short perf note. :thumbsup:
